scope: Defined conventional rule/forecast bundle vs fixed AI with a common policy on reused Dev; not human or organizational effectiveness

train.validationMeaning: Inputs, finite outputs, balanced treatments and provenance validated; does not require AI to outperform rules.

dev.validationMeaning: Inputs, finite outputs, balanced treatments and provenance validated; does not require AI to outperform rules.

primaryOriginalLoss.scope: Existing Dev exploratory contrasts; source-deletion ranges are not confidence intervals

reproduction.comparison: Every outcome, quantity, initial/final constructed state hash and input hash; wall-clock time excluded

isolation.bundle: Pinned public recovery-v1 weights at separately restored path

complementary.scope: native component diagnostics, not an end-to-end order benchmark

core-retail-train-v1.scope: Frozen complementary snapshot plus source-disjoint original Train sales; no latent demand or organizational efficacy claim

core-tatqa-train-v1.scope: Frozen complementary snapshot plus original Train financial-document annotations; no organizational efficacy claim

core-retail-holdout-v1.scope: Existing inputs unchanged plus frozen unseen-source evaluation; original public Train split reused only for previously unused sources, not model training

core-retail-linked-v1.scope: Original snapshots unchanged; extra observations within existing Train source families

limitations: Only four sources and five periods identify exact primary loss
One regularized classical forecast baseline, not all conventional methods
Fixed common questioning rule; no learned-value policy effect
Accuracy includes correct missing states, not universal order readiness
